name: Mesh
description: The Mesh MCP connects Claude directly to Mesh, giving it real-time access to your company's spend data, cards, policies, and approvals. Ask Claude to pull expense reports, flag anomalies, manage card limits, or trigger workflows, without touching the Mesh app.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mesh to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mesh to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.meshpayments.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mesh MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mesh provides these MCP tools: cardRequest, getCardTransactions, getCustomFieldDefinitions, getExpenses, getMyCompanies, getMyRecentTransactions, getMyVirtualCards, getOrganizationContacts, getSpendCategories, showMfaWidget, showReceiptUploadWidget, and whoAmI.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mesh?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mesh in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Mesh requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mesh is developed by Mesh. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
